prompts.text: Where have you been forcing what wanted adjustment?
What has “in tune” felt like in the body or the atmosphere around you?
Right now, I am being tuned … what resonates?

blocks.title: One act of tuning
blocks.instruction: Choose one act of tuning instead of pushing. Adjust a space, schedule, sentence, or commitment until it sounds more true.

blocks.closing: Hum once. Feel what resonance does in the body.
